use: STUDY ONLY. Reference values for judging and for explaining why the page works. Never paste these values as a set into a RIG or client site: TRADEMARKS.md forbids using the official website's look for another product.

color.--spark: #ff5a1f (the one action color: primary button fill, arrows, nav underline, ::selection; 4 uses)

contrast_measured.spark_on_paper: 2.72 (never used as text on paper, only as fill or mark)

families.--mono: Geist Mono 400/500 (11px uppercase labels, Terminal command)
families.--hand: Nanum Pen Script 400 (kickers and asides in the mascot's voice)

type.loading: Google Fonts css2, display=swap, preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com

scale.label: 400 11px Geist Mono, letter-spacing .14em, uppercase, ink-soft
scale.kicker: 32px/1 Nanum Pen Script, pen blue, rotate(-2deg)

spacing.scale_note: custom, not a 4/8 grid: common values 10, 22, 26, 56, 130-140px (Dembrandt scaleType custom)

border.common: 2px solid ink (16 uses); hairline 1px top rules rgba(22,28,46,.16) between list rows

shadow.style: hard offset, zero blur, ink colored: 4px 4px, 5px 5px, 6px 6px, 7px 7px, 10px 10px 0 var(--ink)
shadow.texture: body::after fixed SVG feTurbulence noise, opacity .45, mix-blend-mode multiply (paper tooth)

motion.--pop: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1) (overshoot spring; 15 uses, wordmark tilt and button press)
motion.durations: 0.2s buttons, 0.3-0.35s links and nav underline, 0.5s nav shade, 1.1s section reveal and hero rise
motion.reveal: .reveal translateY(36px) + opacity 0 -> on, IntersectionObserver threshold .12, rootMargin 0 0 -6% 0, once
motion.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) kills every animation and transition and shows reveals; eye tracking and blinking are skipped in JS
